title: Power BI Deployment Pipeline Stage Failures
dataSources: Power BI activity events (`o365:management:activity` with `Workload=PowerBI`), Power BI REST Admin API (`/admin/groups`, `/datasets/refreshes`, `/capacities/refreshables`), on-prem data gateway `Mashup`/`GatewayInfo` logs, Premium capacity metrics.
app: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services / Microsoft 365 (`Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices`) for the Power BI activity log; Power BI REST Admin API and on-prem data gateway logs via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=o365:management:activity Workload=PowerBI (Activity=DeployedToPipelineStage OR Activity=CreatedPipeline)
| stats count as deployments, sum(eval(Result="Failed")) as failures by PipelineName, Activity
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Monitors Power BI deployment-pipeline promotions between Dev, Test, and Prod and flags failed deployments that leave environments out of sync.
value: A failed promotion can leave production on an old report version or break a release; tracking pipeline outcomes keeps the content lifecycle reliable.
implementation: Ingest the activity log; schedule hourly; alert on failed deployments. Correlate with the change-management record.
visualization: Table of pipeline deployments by outcome, timeline of promotions.

references.title: Power BI — Track user activities (audit log)

grandmaExplanation: We keep track of when Power BI reports are pushed from testing to live and flag any push that failed, so production stays correct.
